author: GameTrailers
description:
Join developer Reissad Studio for a deep dive into what you can expect from The Dead & Damned update for Bodycam, the first tactical multiplayer FPS game with a true body-camera view in Unreal Engine 5. The Dead & Damned update for Bodycam features the return of the Zombies mode, a new map, new systems, and improvements to the experience. Learn how zombies move, how to survive through exploration, and how to progress. 

Additionally, version 0.9 brings the advances from the Lock & Loaded update, including the new weapon handling, new animations and reloads, and the stress system. Changes also include changes to weapon boxes, where they can now come with random attachments like sights and suppressors. A new rarer box will also be added: the loadout box. The ragdoll stumbling system applies to the infected in version 0.9. The video also gives you a closer look at the maps, your objectives, and much more. 

The Bodycam version 0.9 update, The Dead and Damned, launches on November 13, 202
title: Bodycam Zombie - Official 'The Dead and Damned' Behind the Scenes Look

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the live action launch trailer for Stellar Blade: Complete Edition, and join EVE on an adventure in this action RPG. In Stellar Blade, step into the role of EVE, an elite warrior sent to reclaim Earth from mysterious forces. Experience intense combat and a twisting plot as you unravel the mysteries of Earth’s downfall in an immersive sci-fi world.

Stellar Blade: Complete Edition includes DLCs for Nier: Automata, Goddess of Victory: Nikke, and the Bayonetta collaboration. Stellar Blade: Complete Edition is available now on Nintendo Switch 2.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics is available now on PC Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2. Check out the latest Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics trailer for this expansion for the strategy game. In Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics, take on the role of a Funfair Expert, and prepare to reopen the gates of Two Point County’s once-legendary amusement park, after a decades-long hiatus. 

Create your own personalized coasters across five unique themes, embark on expeditions to the abandoned Gearbox Fairgrounds, discover the new museum location: Riquetti Gardens, discover a new five-star story campaign, collect ten new mascots, curate over 15 Funfair exhibits, get new Gift Shop items, discover Funfair-themed items and decorations, landscape with new hedges, fences, and outdoor items, and enjoy a new range of utility items like the Helipad, Ticket Desk, benches, bins, and more.

description:
Yomawari: The Long Night Collection and Yomawari: Lost in the Dark are available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5). Check out the Yomawari: The Long Night Collection & Yomawari: Lost in the Dark PS5 launch trailer to see the terrors that await you in this survival horror series collection. 

Yomawari: The Long Night Collection features Yomawari: Night Alone and Yomawari: Midnight Shadows. Traverse the haunting world of Yomawari: Night Alone as a young girl searches for her sister, or share in the terrors that schoolgirls Yui and Haru face in Yomawari: Midnight Shadows. Uncover the mysteries plaguing a rural Japanese town, hide from the things lurking in the night, and maybe get home alive. But don't forget, the dark is no place to be alone.

To break a curse placed on her, a young girl must venture into the haunted streets of her town at night in search of her lost memories in Yomawari: Lost in the Dark. However, malevolent ghosts lurk within the shadows, and she must avoid them by running,
title: Yomawari: The Long Night Collection & Yomawari: Lost in the Dark - Official PS5 Launch Trailer

description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for Astral Dive, an upcoming story-driven RPG featuring deck-building mechanics. Astral Dive will be available on PC, PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch in 2027.

Astral Dive invites players to step into the shoes of Atlas, a young mage, as he investigates mysterious events that shook the foundations of his magic academy many years ago. To uncover the truth, he’ll need to cross into new, fascinating dimensions by traversing astral portals. Along the way, he will befriend more allies, each with a unique past to discover and special abilities to add to the party.
